squirrel.core.error_handlers

class squirrel.core.error_handlers.AppException(status_code=500, detail='Internal server error')[source]

Bases: Exception

Base application exception class.

Provides customizable status codes and detail messages for application errors. All custom exception classes inherit from this base class.

Parameters:

  • status_code (int) – HTTP status code for the error (default: 500)

  • detail (str) – Detailed error message for the client

class squirrel.core.error_handlers.NotFoundException(detail='Resource not found')[source]

Bases: AppException

Exception raised when a resource is not found.

Returns HTTP 404 Not Found status code with optional custom detail message.

Parameters:

detail (str) – Descriptive message about the missing resource (default: “Resource not found”)

class squirrel.core.error_handlers.BadRequestException(detail='Invalid request')[source]

Bases: AppException

Exception raised when the request is invalid.

Returns HTTP 400 Bad Request status code with optional custom detail message.

Parameters:

detail (str) – Descriptive message about the request error (default: “Invalid request”)

class squirrel.core.error_handlers.UnauthorizedException(detail='Not authorized')[source]

Bases: AppException

Exception raised when the user is not authorized.

Returns HTTP 401 Unauthorized status code with optional custom detail message.

Parameters:

detail (str) – Descriptive message about the authorization error (default: “Not authorized”)
